mutations.name: git push long options are not resolved from a prefix
kills: an abbreviated git push long option reads --ta as --tags, a tag push
an abbreviated git push long option reads --al as --all, a push of every branch
handle: an abbreviated git push long option denies git push origin feat/x --ta

mutations.name: an ambiguous git push option prefix passes
kills: an abbreviated git push long option reads the ambiguous --t, --tags or --thin as a push to an unknown branch
handle: an abbreviated git push long option denies git push --t origin feat/x

mutations.name: an abbreviated --repo takes no value
kills: an abbreviated git push long option reads the word after an abbreviated --repo as its value, so main names the remote
